title: CISA added two exploited CISA KEV vulnerabilities to its catalog. Patch WSO2 and Adobe Commerce to secure systems against active attacks. #
content_md:
CISA added two exploited CISA KEV vulnerabilities to its catalog. Patch WSO2 and Adobe Commerce to secure systems against active attacks. # 

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/cisa-kev-vulnerabilities-wso2-adobe/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-5430.evidence: Event reports CISA added two exploited flaws to KEV on 2026-09-24, including WSO2 CVE-2026-5430 (CVSS 10.0, JWT algorithm mismatch auth bypass).

CVE-2026-71362.evidence: Same event reports the Adobe Commerce incorrect-authorization flaw CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1) as exploited and KEV-listed with August 2026 security release fixes.
